terms.meaning: A list of numbers that represents the meaning of a piece of text, so similar texts can be compared.
Another word for a list of numbers in this context.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and logger setup
sections.what: Loads the embedding connectors, the settings, and the logger.
sections.why: Likely reason: needed to create the embedding service and record errors.

sections.name: EmbeddingsManager
sections.title: Embeddings manager
sections.what: Creates the embedding service from settings and provides methods that embed a list of documents or one question, passing any error on after logging it.
sections.why: Likely reason: callers do not need to know which provider is used.
sections.watch_out: If the embedding model changes, old stored vectors no longer match, so the documents must be indexed again.

summary: Creates the component that turns text into lists of numbers, which the search uses to find similar passages.
purpose: Provides one place to get embeddings for documents and for questions.
why: Likely reason: keeps the choice between Azure and standard OpenAI in one place.
how: On creation, it picks Azure or OpenAI embedding settings from the config. The document and question methods call the chosen service and log any error before passing it on.
inputs: Lists of text for documents, or one text for a question.
outputs: Lists of numbers for each text.
risks: Every text is sent to a paid service, and failures are not retried. Changing the embedding model makes previously stored numbers incompatible.
debug: Look for the Using OpenAI embeddings or Using Azure OpenAI embeddings line at start. Error embedding log lines show the failure. If results become poor after a model change, index the documents again.
